project.name: Arabic Name Image Generator Backend
project.description: Backend, image rendering engine, tracking, analytics, QA, deployment, and security for the Arabic Name Image Generator system.

orchestrator.ready_rule: A task is READY when all dependency task ids are in DONE state.
execution_rules: Route each READY task to its owner_agent
Execute with the matching prompt pack
Mark task as DONE, NEEDS_REVISION, or BLOCKED
Repeat until all tasks are DONE or terminally BLOCKED

milestones.name: Backend Architecture
milestones.description: Define backend, rendering, and analytics architecture.

milestones.name: Image Engine
milestones.description: Build Arabic text layout and PNG rendering engine.

milestones.name: Core Backend APIs
milestones.description: Build generation API and optional persistence.

milestones.name: Tracking and Analytics
milestones.description: Build event collection, storage, sessions, and metrics.

milestones.name: QA and Validation
milestones.description: Validate backend behavior, rendering, analytics, and performance.

milestones.name: Deployment and Security
milestones.description: Deploy backend and validate monitoring and security.

tasks.title: Validate Backend Scope
tasks.description: Confirm that project scope is backend-only and excludes frontend redesign or rebuild.
acceptance_criteria: No UI build tasks are included
Backend, image engine, analytics, QA, DevOps, and security scope are explicit
Frontend is marked as locked and integration-only

tasks.title: Define Backend Architecture
tasks.description: Design backend architecture including API layer, image engine, and analytics boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Clear separation between API, image engine, and analytics services

tasks.title: Define Image Rendering Strategy
tasks.description: Choose rendering approach and define flow for Arabic text rendering onto static templates.
acceptance_criteria: Performance is acceptable for target load

tasks.title: Define Data and Tracking Architecture
tasks.description: Design data model and event tracking architecture for analytics and reporting.

tasks.title: Implement Text Layout Engine
tasks.description: Build logic to fit Arabic names inside a constrained area with RTL support and line limits.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic font sizing works for long names

tasks.title: Implement Image Rendering
tasks.description: Generate high-resolution PNG output with correctly placed Arabic text.

tasks.title: Define API Contract
tasks.description: Define the contract for the image generation API.

tasks.title: Implement Input Validation
tasks.description: Implement validation rules for image generation input payloads.

tasks.title: Implement Image Generation API
tasks.description: Build the /api/generate endpoint and integrate it with the rendering engine.
acceptance_criteria: Response time is under 3 seconds for expected conditions

tasks.title: Implement Storage Optional Path
tasks.description: Implement optional database persistence for generated records if persistence is enabled.
acceptance_criteria: No significant performance regression is introduced

tasks.title: Create Event Tracking API
tasks.description: Build the event ingestion endpoint for analytics tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Rejects malformed payloads with structured errors

tasks.title: Implement Event Storage
tasks.description: Persist tracking events in the analytics datastore.
acceptance_criteria: No data loss under normal operation

tasks.title: Implement Session Tracking
tasks.description: Add session identification and tracking model for users and visitors.
acceptance_criteria: Session-level user activity can be linked

tasks.title: Build Aggregation Engine
tasks.description: Create logic to compute KPIs and aggregated analytics data from stored events.
acceptance_criteria: Queries are performant for expected dataset sizes

tasks.title: Create Stats APIs
tasks.description: Expose metrics and analytics summaries through backend endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Date filters and core dimensions are supported

tasks.title: Backend Functional Testing
tasks.description: Validate backend endpoints and main execution flows.

tasks.title: Image Output Validation
tasks.description: Validate image generation output quality, Arabic rendering, and layout behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No layout overflow or clipping issues remain

tasks.title: Analytics Validation
tasks.description: Validate event collection, stored data, and computed metrics for correctness.

tasks.title: Performance Testing
tasks.description: Test performance characteristics of generation and analytics endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Generation response time remains under 3 seconds in target conditions
System remains stable under expected load

tasks.title: Deploy Backend
tasks.description: Deploy backend services to the target environment.
acceptance_criteria: Environment variables and runtime config are correctly set

tasks.title: Setup Monitoring
tasks.description: Implement logs, health checks, and alerting for backend operations.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Perform security review for backend endpoints, data handling, and deployment posture.
acceptance_criteria: Core backend security controls are present

final_outputs: Stored tracking events and session model
